More colors, more control, and a preview you can trust. Update from HACS, restart Home Assistant, and you're set: your apps keep working as they are.

## ✨ What's new

### 🎨 A label in its own color
In simple mode, the label of an entity can now have a color of its own, different from the value's: a white `Pool` before a blue `27.5°C`, for example. It works for one entity, for several on a line, and in the layouts of the TC002.

### 🖼️ A default icon for template apps
Template apps get the icon picker too. The icon you choose goes to every page that names none, so you no longer type it in each page of your template.

### 🕒 The time above your value, on the TC002
A new layout, **Value and time**, shows the current time above the value. No time sensor needed.

Also in layouts: unticking **Center** now starts the text at the left of its box.

### 🌈 More ways to scroll and to color on AWTRIX NG
A text too long for the screen can now **loop** or **bounce**. A rainbow or gradient text can move, at the speed and width you choose.

### 🔧 Easier to set up and to look after
- **Reconfigure a clock.** Change its MQTT prefix or its firmware without removing it. If you protected the clock's web page, give its user name and password there.
- **AWTRIX NG clocks are found by themselves.** Home Assistant offers to add them as soon as they show up on your MQTT broker.
- **Diagnostics.** Download a clock's diagnostics from Home Assistant to join to a bug report. They hold no password, address or template.

## 🛠️ Fixed
- 🎨 **Colors on a line of entities (AWTRIX NG).** As on AWTRIX 3, each entity now keeps its own color.
- 📦 **Apps too large for an AWTRIX NG clock.** The clock drops them without a word. Awtrix Studio no longer sends them and says why in the panel, exactly at the size where the clock gives up. What the clock refuses for another reason shows in the panel as well.
- 🧩 **Layouts the clock refused.** A layout with an effect whose colors were set not to blend, but without a palette, never showed. It does now.
- 🔍 **A preview closer to the clock on AWTRIX NG.** Checked pixel by pixel against a TC002 and a TC001: text sits in its box where the clock puts it, progress bars have the clock's length, a rainbow or gradient paints the whole text of a layout, and on a TC002 that does not enlarge apps, a one-line app is drawn in the middle of the screen.

## ⬆️ Updating
Nothing to do: your apps, icons and settings are kept. Try a color on one of your labels to see the difference. 😉
